steps.title: 👥 Target users with Segments
steps.description:
Segments are reusable audience groups. Define a segment once, use it across multiple configs.

Examples:
• 'Beta Users' → plan equals 'pro'
• 'EU Users' → country in [DE, FR, ES, IT]
• 'Internal' → email ends with '@yourcompany.com'

When you add a targeting rule to a config, you can target an entire segment instead of writing conditions each time.

steps.title: Manage Segments
steps.description: Create and edit audience segments here. You'll see which configs use each segment.

steps.title: 💡 How segments work in practice
steps.description:
1. Create a segment: 'Premium Users' (plan = pro)
2. Go to any config → Targeting Rules
3. Add rule: operator 'in_segment', value 'Premium Users'
4. That config value now only applies to premium users

Bonus: The usage indicator shows how many configs reference each segment, so you know the impact of changes.
